name: Claude Code
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI from its official release bucket, verified against the release manifest's sha256, then adds marketplaces and plugins and merges settings each time the container is created.

marketplaces.description: Comma-separated marketplaces to add, as owner/repo[#ref] (GitHub) or a git URL. Empty adds none.

plugins.description: Comma-separated plugins to install for the user, as plugin@marketplace. Empty installs none.

settings.description: JSON object merged into ~/.claude/settings.json, e.g. {'model':'sonnet','env':{'EDITOR':'vim'}}. Write its quotes as single quotes: the container CLI drops double quotes. An apostrophe inside a value is written \u0027 (\\u0027 in devcontainer.json). Empty changes nothing.
